replace_with_spqr_linear: replace nn.Linear layers in a PyTorch model with SPQR quantized layers using a quantization config
quantize_model_spqr: quantize a PyTorch model by replacing its linear layers with SPQR sparse-quantized representations
skip_modules_spqr: replace linear layers with SPQR quantized layers while skipping specified modules from conversion
build_spqr_quantized_model: build a quantized PyTorch model by converting nn.Linear modules to QuantizedLinear via SPQR
review_replace_spqr: review the replace_with_spqr_linear function that substitutes linear layers with SPQR quantized placeholders
